name: Tiffany Gorman Dean
occupation: Platte County coroner-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Tiffany Gorman Dean is the Platte County coroner-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Philip G. Martin, who is serving through the current term. The official 2026 general election summary lists her with 3,215 votes. The official coroner page uses a tdean email address; no mid-term appointment replacing Martin was found in the public records reviewed for this Profile.
